family_name: Autex Grid Ceiling Tiles - Linear/Hatch/Angle/Louvre - Square - Capped

spec.description:
Autex Grid Ceiling Tiles - Linear/Hatch/Angle/Louvre - Square - Capped is a
modular 595mm x 595mm 3D acoustic ceiling tile designed for standard 600mm
x 600mm suspended grid systems. Available in directional Linear, cross-hatch
Hatch, slanted Angle, or Louvre designs, this capped variant incorporates an
integrated acoustic backing cap that conceals overhead plenum services. Crafted
from 100% polyester fibre with a minimum of 60% recycled PET, it provides
exceptional acoustic absorption (NRC 0.60 - 0.75+) and Group 1 fire safety.

install:
Confirm 600mm x 600mm suspended grid is
level and square

Ensure all tiles for the space are from the same production
batch

Assemble slatted square tile with its backing cap securely fastened to
the top

Tilt the assembled capped tile and pass it upward through the grid
opening
Lower onto the grid tees, ensuring edges seat evenly on all sides

Align directional slats consistently or create alternating quarter-turn
checkerboard patterns
selection_checklist:
Select desired style: Linear
(parallel slats), Hatch (cross-hatch), Angle (slanted), or Louvre (louvred)
Confirm grid size is square metric 600mm x 600mm

Confirm capped version is
selected for maximum sound absorption and complete plenum concealment

Choose
colour from Autex Cube palette
accessories: Standard two-way exposed ceiling grid (15mm or 24mm tee)
limitations:
Tile depth
(approx 80-103mm) requires adequate clearance beneath overhead services

Not
designed for direct exposure to water leaks, steam, or outdoor weather

Do not
mix batches in the same contiguous ceiling area

use_cases:
Upgrading standard 600x600 square drop ceilings in meeting rooms and
collaborative zones with slatted 3D textures that conceal overhead services

School classrooms and library quiet zones requiring high acoustic absorption
(NRC up to 0.75+) and Group 1 fire safety

Boutique hospitality and retail
fitouts seeking a warm slatted ceiling appearance with drop-in simplicity
not_for: Direct floor traffic or wall impact surfaces

Unframed ceilings
without a supporting T-bar grid

Outdoor unconditioned soffits or external
canopies

Autex Grid Ceiling Tiles -
Linear/Hatch/Angle/Louvre - Square - Capped is a modular 595mm x 595mm 3D

Available in Linear, Hatch, Angle, or Louvre profiles, this capped variant
